entries.justification: The complete owned source imposes an explicit release action constraint: Aster may promote a build only after 12 uninterrupted passing minutes; a failure resets this timer.
The owned Nacre approval rule imposes a reviewer-count prerequisite for manifest approval: two distinct reviewer identities; repeated submissions by one person do not satisfy it.
The complete owned source imposes an explicit release action constraint: Vireo revision 4 requires selecting exactly one of the red and blue channels for each release.
